description: Smart City Sensor Data \u2013 General Dataset for Testing and Research is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Allan Hatfield. "This dataset contains simulated environmental and traffic sensor data collected from a fictional smart city over a 24-hour period. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
